# utils.solver.validate_initial_state { #climatecritters.utils.solver.validate_initial_state }

```python
utils.solver.validate_initial_state(
    y0,
    integrated_state_vars,
    state_variables_names,
)
```

Validate and normalize the initial state vector.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**y0**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Proposed initial state.

<code>[**integrated_state_vars**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[list](`list`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Names of integrated (ODE) state variables.

<code>[**state_variables_names**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[list](`list`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   All declared state variable names.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**y0_arr**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ndarray](`ndarray`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Validated, flattened float array.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the length of ``y0`` is inconsistent with the declared state variable counts.
